entry.author: Nelson City Council
entry.summary:
Take an autumn lunch time walk with us around beautiful Queens Gardens.
 
Nelson’s parks and reserves are truely putting on a show with all the colours.
 
Queens gardens was opened in 1892 to commemorate the jubilee of Queen Victoria. It was designed around a residual bend of the Maitai River known as the ‘Eel Pond’, a site with significance to Māori, and reflects a classic Victorian style garden. 

It is a category II listed historic place.

You can also wander through the Huangshi Chinese Garden within Queens gardens. 

A serene spot to walk or stay a while.
